feedback: The RM is well-formed and faithful to the task 'move the ball off the door before you take the key; pick up the box.' FORMAT: header, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, nonempty FINAL_STATES (u4, declared and accepting — reached exactly on target_picked_up, the mission's success), per-state else self-loops, and predicate-only conditions over the five defined propositions all match the paper format; nonzero-only reward listing with implicit 0 on else-loops is standard. SEMANTIC FIDELITY / ORDERING: u0->u1 requires blocker_moved without the key, and u1->u2 requires blocker_moved & has_door_key, so the key-take is credited only while the ball is off the door cell — this correctly refuses progression if the agent drops the ball back before taking the key (blocker_moved is a non-latch, and the guard re-checks it at exactly the step the task's ordering is decided). No explicit state regressions are needed: after u2 the ball cannot be held (key in hand), door_open physically requires the ball off the toggle cell, and the door cannot be relocked, so milestone states remain valid; the guards are the explicit regression handling where it matters. EVENT/CONDITION DISTINCTION: key_lost is used strictly as a one-step event trigger; compliant flows never fire it (the only necessary key drop occurs after door_open, and key_lost requires the door closed), so the -0.1 penalties land only on real violations or pointless drops: u0 key_lost = key taken before the ball moved (pickup itself is absorbed by else, but the drop is forced for any completion, so every violation is punished); u1 key_lost = key taken while the ball was back, then dropped; u2 key_lost = key dropped before opening. REACHABILITY: u4 is reachable on the canonical path (pickup ball -> drop away -> pickup key -> toggle -> drop key -> pickup box = 0.1+0.2+0.3+1.0 = 1.6), and violation paths recover (drop key -> -0.1 -> ball -> key -> proceed, total 1.5), fitting the soft 'try to' ordering without deadlocking any state — every state retains an action path to u4 within the 576-step limit. REWARD SAFETY: no backward edges, each milestone transition fires once (repeated ball pickup/drop at u1 yields no repeat +0.1), so positives are bounded at 1.6 and dense across progress; penalties are agent-induced and cannot be farmed for gain. Minor harmless notes: the !has_door_key and !key_lost guards on u0->u1 are redundant (at any u0 step where blocker_moved is true the agent just picked up the ball with empty hands, so both guards are satisfied and never block a deserved transition) but document the intended ordering; (u1, key_lost) is live only via the ball-returned path, where it is apt. No rewriting performed.

The x > 0 guard short-circuits before env.grid.get(x-1, y), so no out-of-range read occurs, and all cells are guarded with 'is not None' before attribute access. has_door_key, door_open, and target_picked_up match the reference expressions verbatim (carrying state via env.carrying, mission match via env.mission f-string, door scan by type with is_open). key_lost is a correct event: it reads env.episode_memory['previous_valuation'] strictly read-only, requires previous has_door_key true, current has_door_key false (inlined K expression), and door_open false (inlined D expression), matching prev['has_door_key'] and not K and not D; the truthiness guard on the previous valuation is harmless because the valuation is always a populated complete dict, and it enforces the documented exclusivity with has_door_key, door_open, and target_picked_up. No imports, no actions or side effects, no mutation of env or episode memory, and the one-liner defs are valid executable Python.
